# Generated by tools/gen-jobs.mjs; do not edit. Faction jobs for members of
# the Republic, the Free Worlds and the Syndicate while their faction is at war:
# intercept a courier, destroy a scout, scout enemy systems, destroy a medium
# warship, destroy a capital ship (Lieutenant and up), and break a warfleet
# (Commander and up). The mod keeps "diplomacy: member", "diplomacy: enemy" and
# "diplomacy: rank"; completing a job adds to "diplomacy: merit", and to
# "diplomacy: intel" or "diplomacy: blows", which the mod turns into war score.


mission "Diplomacy: Republic Job: Courier vs Free Worlds"
	name "Intercept <npc>"
	job
	repeat
	description "The Free Worlds courier <npc> is carrying orders through a system near <system>. Destroy it by <day>. Payment is <payment> on the kill, and it counts toward your merit."
	deadline 12
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 1
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		random < 60
	source
		government "Republic"
	npc kill
		government "Free Worlds Flotilla"
		personality timid staying marked target tracked
		system
			distance 1 3
			government "Free Worlds"
		fleet
			names "free worlds small"
			variant
				"Sparrow"
		on kill
			payment 60000
			"diplomacy: merit" += 3
			dialog "With the <npc> destroyed, its orders will never reach the Free Worlds. The Navy transfers <payment> to your account."
			fail

mission "Diplomacy: Republic Job: Scout Ship vs Free Worlds"
	name "Destroy the scout <npc>"
	job
	repeat
	description "A fast Free Worlds scout, the <npc>, is mapping our defenses from a system near <system>. Destroy it by <day> before it reports back. Payment is <payment> on the kill, and it counts toward your merit."
	deadline 12
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 1
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		random < 60
	source
		government "Republic"
	npc kill
		government "Free Worlds Flotilla"
		personality timid staying marked target tracked
		system
			distance 1 3
			government "Free Worlds"
		fleet
			names "free worlds small"
			variant
				"Hawk (Speedy)"
		on kill
			payment 70000
			"diplomacy: merit" += 3
			dialog "The <npc> will not be reporting to the Free Worlds. The Navy transfers <payment> to your account."
			fail

mission "Diplomacy: Republic Job: Scout System vs Free Worlds"
	name "Scout <waypoints>"
	job
	repeat
	description "Fly through <waypoints>, held by the Free Worlds, and bring what you see back to <planet> by <date>. Payment is <payment>, and it counts toward your merit."
	deadline
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 1
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		random < 60
	source
		government "Republic"
	waypoint
		distance 1 3
		government "Free Worlds"
	on complete
		payment 40000 400
		"diplomacy: merit" += 4
		"diplomacy: intel" += 2
		dialog `A Navy intelligence officer downloads your sensor logs from <waypoints> and pays you <payment>. "That's exactly what we needed on the Free Worlds positions."`

mission "Diplomacy: Republic Job: Medium Warship vs Free Worlds"
	name "Destroy the <npc>"
	job
	repeat
	description "The <npc>, a Free Worlds warship, is raiding from a system near <system>. Destroy it by <day>. Payment is <payment> on the kill, and it counts toward your merit."
	deadline 15
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 1
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		"diplomacy: rank" >= 1
		random < 45
	source
		government "Republic"
	npc kill
		government "Free Worlds Flotilla"
		personality heroic staying marked target tracked
		system
			distance 1 4
			government "Free Worlds"
		fleet
			names "free worlds small"
			variant
				"Osprey (Missile)"
		on kill
			payment 220000
			"diplomacy: merit" += 6
			dialog "The <npc> is destroyed. The Navy transfers <payment> to your account."
			fail

mission "Diplomacy: Republic Job: Warfleet vs Free Worlds"
	name "Break a warfleet near <system>"
	job
	repeat
	description "A Free Worlds warfleet, led by the <npc>, is massing in a system near <system>. Destroy every ship in it by <day>. Payment is <payment> when the last one falls, and it counts heavily toward your merit."
	deadline 25
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 1
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		"diplomacy: rank" >= 3
		random < 25
	source
		government "Republic"
	npc kill
		government "Free Worlds Flotilla"
		personality heroic staying marked target tracked
		system
			distance 1 4
			government "Free Worlds"
		fleet "Large Free Worlds"
		on kill
			payment 1800000
			"diplomacy: merit" += 30
			dialog "The last ship of the warfleet is destroyed. The Navy transfers <payment> to your account, and word of the battle spreads."
			fail

		fleet
			names "syndicate small"
			variant
				"Manta"
		on kill

			fail

mission "Diplomacy: Syndicate Job: Scout System vs Free Worlds"
	name "Scout <waypoints>"
	job
	repeat
	description "Fly through <waypoints>, held by the Free Worlds, and bring what you see back to <planet> by <date>. Payment is <payment>, and it counts toward your merit."
	deadline
	to offer
		"diplomacy: member" == 3
		"diplomacy: enemy" == 2
		random < 60
	source
		government "Syndicate"
	waypoint
		distance 1 3
		government "Free Worlds"
	on complete
		payment 40000 400
		"diplomacy: merit" += 4
		"diplomacy: intel" += 2
		dialog `A Syndicate security liaison downloads your sensor logs from <waypoints> and pays you <payment>. "That's exactly what we needed on the Free Worlds positions."`
